steps.tx: **Bordet Gengou medium** (potato infusion agar with glycerol and sheep blood) grows Bordetella pertussis as mercury drop pearl colonies in 3 to 7 days, cough plate heritage at bedside, charcoal blood Regan Lowe transport and culture successor, both humbled by PCR speed yet culture retains isolates for typing and resistance. Cough plates held directly before a coughing child were dramatic but inconsistent, and modern methods are more reliable.
steps.say: Pearl drops on potato blood agar in a week; PCR answers tonight, culture types tomorrow.

left.title: Bordet Gengou design
points: Potato glycerol base neutralises fatty acids

right.title: Modern pathway
points: Nasopharyngeal aspirate better than swab infants
Culture in outbreaks and vaccine studies

steps.tx: **Legionella pneumophila** is a water system gram negative (pools, towers, plumbing biofilms with amoebae), requiring cysteine and iron on buffered charcoal yeast extract (BCYE), inhaled aerosols causing Legionnaires pneumonia and Pontiac fever, urinary antigen for serogroup 1 only, culture and PCR completing, person to person essentially absent.
steps.say: Cooling tower aerosols plus hyponatraemic pneumonia: test urine, culture sputum on BCYE.

left.title: Legionella identity
points: Weak gram staining, silver stains better

steps.tx: **Legionella diagnosis ladder**: urinary antigen rapid (serogroup 1 about 80 percent), lower respiratory culture on BCYE and selective variants (species and serogroups beyond urinary), PCR increasingly first, serology retrospective; negative urine antigen never excludes non serogroup 1 or early disease.
steps.say: Urine antigen catches the commonest serogroup quickly; culture catches the rest slowly.

right.title: Culture duties
points: BCYE non selective and selective plates

steps.tx: **Legionella water control** (temperature regimes hot above 60 and cold below 20, flushing dead legs, disinfection chlorine and monchloramine and copper silver, cooling tower registries and maintenance) is environmental microbiology as regulation; outbreaks audit logs, not luck.
steps.say: Legionella is managed in engineering logs before it is treated in lungs.

left.title: Building controls
points: Hot water storage and return temperatures
Dead leg removal and flushing schedules

steps.tx: **Brucella** species (melitensis goats, abortus cattle, suis pigs, canis dogs) are tiny gram negative coccobacilli, facultative intracellular, causing undulant fever, sacroiliitis, epididymo orchitis, endocarditis chronic, laboratory hazard aerosol (BSL3 practices), Castaneda biphasic culture heritage (next lesson) and serology mainstay.
steps.say: Undulant fever plus animal or laboratory exposure: Brucella until serology and cultures answer.

vis.alt: Brucella plague and tularaemia zoonotic bacteria illustrations
vis.caption: Haemophilus, pertussis, Brucella, plague and tularaemia zoonotic group.

steps.tx: **Brucellosis diagnosis**: blood cultures automated (extended alert laboratory, slow small colonies), Rose Bengal screening agglutination, standard agglutination titres and Coombs for chronic, ELISA and PCR niche, bone marrow yield; tell the laboratory because Brucella infects benches classically.
steps.say: Write suspected Brucella on the form; the organism infects laboratorians by aerosol.

left.title: Serology
points: Coombs and 2 mercaptoethanol chronic incomplete antibodies
Cross reaction tularemia and cholera vaccine folklore

right.title: Culture
points: Automated blood culture usually under week (alert lab)
Castaneda biphasic heritage reduces subculture aerosols

steps.tx: **Brucellosis therapy** is prolonged combination (doxycycline plus rifampicin six weeks, aminoglycoside first weeks in severe and endocarditis triple longer) because intracellular sanctuary relapses on short courses; focal disease (spondylitis, endocarditis, neurobrucellosis) extends and surgeons join endocarditis.
steps.say: Six weeks two drugs minimum; intracellular Brucella punishes short courses with relapse.

right.title: Relapse logic
points: No human vaccine; animal control and milk pasteurisation

steps.tx: **Zoonotic gram negative bench grouping** from this module onward: Brucella (animal products), Yersinia (plague and enteric), Francisella (hares and ticks), Pasteurella (bites), Bartonella (cats and lice), each with exposure first history. The animal question is a culture medium.
steps.say: Ask animal, occupation and travel before the plate: zoonoses announce by biography.

right.title: Bench safety echo
points: Brucella, Francisella, Yersinia pestis BSL3 alerts
